name: three terminal windows post to a platform in parallel
looks: Three dark terminal-style windows sit side by side, each showing a different identity connected to the same platform, a short task checklist on the left of each and a live post forming on the right; a small automation mark pulses in the corner of each as it finishes.
build: glass-ui-flow across three parallel panels instead of one: each terminal's checklist items check off top to bottom, the post content types on, staggered a fraction of a second between the three so they read as simultaneous, not sequential.
sound: A soft keystroke texture under the typing, a tick per checklist item, three overlapping soft confirms.
prompt: Show three identical terminal-style panels side by side, each representing a different identity or agent doing the same kind of task on the same platform at once: a short checklist ticking off, then content typing itself in. Stagger the three just enough to read as live and parallel, not copy-pasted.
